Why Your Site Is Probably Leaking Traffic and Sales Right Now

If you're not getting the traffic and conversions you want, there's likely a technical reason why:

  • Google can't properly crawl your site (and we can show you exactly why)
  • Your pages load too slowly on mobile, frustrating visitors and hurting your rankings
  • Critical content is being ignored by search engines due to technical issues
  • Your competitors have fixed these issues (while you might not even know they exist)
  • User experience problems are causing potential customers to bounce

Our Technical SEO Audit helps you identify and resolve these issues before they further damage your search performance and bottom line.

Our Technical SEO Audit Process

1

We Start By Understanding Your Business

What are your most valuable services? Who's your ideal customer? What keywords actually matter to your bottom line? This context makes our technical recommendations actually relevant to your business goals

2

Competitor Analysis

We assess your competitors’ strategies and website features to reveal their strengths — and uncover your growth opportunities

3

We Crawl Your Entire Website

Using professional-grade tools, we examine every corner of your site through the eyes of search engines – finding issues your developer and previous SEO companies have missed

4

Content Quality Review

We analyze the uniqueness, structure, keyword relevance, and effectiveness of your content in driving engagement and rankings

5

Usability & User Experience Check

We identify friction points in the user journey that may be preventing conversions or leading to drop-offs

6

Commercial Effectiveness Evaluation

We review key business elements such as product assortment, filter usability, delivery info, and trust signals that influence buying decisions

7

Link Profile Audit

We examine internal and external links to assess structure, authority, and SEO value

8

Actionable Report & Improvement Plan

You’ll receive a detailed report with clear recommendations and a prioritized roadmap to boost performance
